name: gemma-4-26b
about: Google Gemma 4, mixture of experts (26B, 4B active), BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. Uses Google's recommended sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64) instead of the POC's 0.1: at 0.1 it looped, repeating a phrase inside its answer until the token limit, on about three replies in four (results/superseded). The whitespace setting is kept because it costs nothing.
